purpose: Replay representative common-spherical nonlinear tidal gates with eight lens-geometry starts.
claim_boundary: Universal gravity constants are copied unchanged from the adaptive common-spherical bridge fit.
No gravity constant is fitted to raw lensing.
Only pseudo-elliptical geometry, shear, center, and source positions are fitted to raw training images.
Candidates with missing held-out roots remain failures even when RMS over surviving roots is small.
The replay was selected after viewing two-start results and is a numerical robustness test, not an independent holdout.
All tested scale-free spherical tidal coordinates are deterministic functions of local-to-mean density ratio and are not independent directional mechanisms.
